preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 3 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m must be between 0 and the minimum of n*(n-1)/2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range from 1 to n.
The number of edge descriptions must match the given number of edges m.

preconditions.expression: len(set((a_i, b_i) for a_i, b_i in edges)) == m
preconditions.description: All edges must be unique and there should be no parallel edges.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of edges to add t must be non-negative.
The number of ways to add t edges w must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: t == 0 if any(len(cycle) % 2 == 1 and len(cycle) > 1 for cycle in find_all_cycles(graph)) else t > 0
postconditions.description: t is 0 if there is already an odd-length cycle of more than one vertex in the graph, otherwise t is greater than 0.

postconditions.expression: w == count_ways_to_add_edges(graph, t) if t > 0 else w == 1
postconditions.description: w is the number of ways to add t edges to form an odd-length cycle if t is greater than 0, otherwise w is 1.
